title: Deep learning screen prioritizes anthelmintic candidates against Haemonchus contortus
summary: A multilayer perceptron trained on 15,000 compounds with high-throughput screening data (1% active) reached 83% precision and 81% recall for active compounds, then screened 14.2 million ZINC15 compounds. Ten candidates were tested in vitro, all with significant inhibition of larval and adult motility and development, and two were highly potent. No in vivo data are reported.
ai_technology: Multilayer perceptron classifier trained on high-throughput bioactivity data

evidence.tested: In vitro assays of 10 predicted compounds on H. contortus larvae and adults.
evidence.unknown: In vivo efficacy is not tested; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Screened 14.2 million compounds for candidate nematocidal activity.
